BOUNDARIES AND TRANSPARENCY

Data ethics and decision support

We do not use intrusive surveillance tracking or unauthorised user profiling. We work strictly with verified marketing tools and the operational feedback provided by your own team. The focus is on continuously improving quotation win rates.

Frequently asked questions

How is a website click different from a quotation request?

A click is a recorded website event; a quotation request is a contact actually received by the business. They are separate metrics, so dashboards do not imply that every contact-button click generated a lead.

What does a simple enquiry tracker look like?

One row per enquiry can record date, source when known, requested service, status, next step and quotation outcome. Personal data should be minimised and access limited appropriately.

What if the original lead source is unknown?

The source is marked unknown instead of automatically assigning it to Google Ads or social media. Attribution gaps should remain visible in reports.

What belongs in a useful monthly report?

Available enquiry and quotation counts, measurement integrity checks, relevant business feedback and prioritised next actions. Only observed data should be reported as results.
